subject: quantitative_aptitude
question: A tea connoisseur blends three varieties of Darjeeling tea costing ₹300/kg, ₹360/kg, and ₹480/kg in the proportion 2 : 3 : x. If the blended tea is sold at ₹440 per kg yielding a net profit of 10%, what is the value of x?
explanation: Selling price of blend = ₹440/kg at 10% profit => Mean Cost Price = 440 / 1.10 = ₹400/kg. Weighted average cost equation: [2(300) + 3(360) + x(480)] / (2 + 3 + x) = 400 => [600 + 1080 + 480x] / (5 + x) = 400 => 1680 + 480x = 2000 + 400x => 80x = 320 => x = 4.
